body_html:
The Yoho armless drafting stool brings true task-chair comfort to standing-height work. A compound-curved back delivers real lumbar support while the pneumatic lift, height-adjustable chromed footrest, and seat-depth adjustment let each person dial in their fit — ideal for labs, reception counters, drafting tables, and shared maker stations. Made in Canada by Global Furniture Group.

Features

  • Task mechanism for responsive, all-day seated support
  • Pneumatic seat-height adjustment across a 23.5"–33.5" range
  • Seat-depth adjustment to accommodate a range of users
  • Comfortable compound-curved back for lumbar support
  • Height-adjustable chromed footrest ring
  • Dual-wheel carpet casters for smooth movement
  • Optional height-adjustable T-arms available (model MVL2784)
  • Upholstered in your choice of Grade 1 seating textile or LuxPlus

Specifications

Overall dimensions 19"W x 24"D x 44"H with a 23.5"–33.5" seat-height range; weighs 45 lbs and is rated for users up to 275 lbs on an 8-hour single shift. GREENGUARD, GREENGUARD Gold, and BIFMA LEVEL certified, and backed by a 2-year warranty.

A family-owned Canadian dealer since 1964, Brant Business Interiors is an OECM-eligible supplier — Ontario institutional buyers can purchase without an open tender. Request a Quote for volume pricing and finish selection, or Call 1-800-835-9565.
